title: Bounded Offline Search for Event-Stream Memory Policies
question: Under an eight-record memory budget, how do filtering, overwrite and eviction rules affect synthetic latest-value recall?
hypothesis: Filtering distractors and replacing stale values may improve recall compared with retaining the last eight events.
limitations: This is a hand-designed CPU benchmark, not a novel research result or a model capability evaluation.
Eight records do not imply equal token counts or serialized bytes; byte costs are reported separately.
The generator favors latest-value storage and does not represent natural-language agent tasks.
Candidates and code are human-authored; the local planner performs bounded ordered search, not autonomous code generation.
Holdout seeds share the same generator distribution. Distribution shift and real task generalization are not tested.
The first-write ablation is a fixed diagnostic comparison; it is not used for candidate selection.

sources.title: Local synthetic memory protocol v2
